name: Onsite Optimizer Installer
author: seoplatform

sections.description:
• Simple, non-technical setup
  • Stores the Optimizer ID per site on multisite
  • Adds the code to every page automatically
  • Skips AMP pages, JSON, REST, feeds, robots, trackbacks, login and register
  • Won’t add the code twice if it’s already present

External Services

This plugin loads a script from the SEO Platform CDN to enable the Onsite Optimizer on your site.

  • What service is used and why: It requests https://cdn.seoplatform.io/injector.js to initialize the Onsite Optimizer.
  • What data is sent and when: The configured Optimizer ID (Website ID) is appended as a query parameter websiteId to the script URL whenever front‑end pages are loaded. No other data is transmitted by this plugin.
  • Service provider and policies: Service provided by SEO Platform — Terms: https://seoplatform.io/terms — Privacy: https://seoplatform.io/privacy

Uninstall

Deactivating the plugin keeps your settings. Deleting the plugin removes the saved Optimizer ID for the current site, and for all sites on multisite.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate Onsite Optimizer Installer
  3. Go to Settings → Onsite Optimizer Installer, enter your Optimizer ID, save

short_description: The easiest way to install the Onsite Optimizer on your website. Enter your Optimizer ID and we’ll do the rest. Multisite compatible. Skips AMP.
